g.title: first_city
g.text: and renders through its existing route

g.title: ui->composed
g.text: same selected time; existing timeline gestures

g.title: acceptance
g.text: Installed Park world uses its authored backdrop,
curved path and entrance in the app composition;
placement and depth are recognizable and correct;
forecast/timeline operate; First City remains usable.

g.title: scope
g.text: This slice creates the Park world composition used by the app.
Backdrop, curved path and entrance stay as its components;
later slices may refine authored geometry and artwork.
Mural/data surface, vegetation and benches, shelter,
pack import and cross-world style parity remain later work.
Concept reference informs landmarks only; its sample readings,
weather, logo and detailed artwork are not requirements.
Focused OX-25 tests and installed evidence only; no broad matrix.

g.title: invariant
g.text: Preserve OX-19: changing worlds does not change
place, catalog revision, exact selected instant,
or trigger a forecast fetch / process restart.
Atmospheric art remains decorative; forecast values
and timeline remain the readable source of facts.
